Test 1 with just one file - approxNA is working for our jugad

```{r}
setwd("D:/NCF/data/variables/cropped rasters/")
library(terra)
library(raster)

# -------------------------------
# Set paths
# -------------------------------

# Reference raster (BIO01)
ref_path <- "temp_bio_1/AP_CHELSA_bio1_1981-2010_V.2.1.tif"

# Input folder with rasters to resample
input_dir <- "raster_raw"

#Output folder
output_dir <- "resampled_filled"

# -------------------------------
# Load reference raster
# -------------------------------

ref_raster <- rast(ref_path)

# -------------------------------
# List input rasters
# -------------------------------

raster_files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
r <- rast("raster_raw/NVDI_MAY_AP_2015.tif")
r_resampled <- resample(r, ref_raster, method = "bilinear")
writeRaster(r_resampled, "r_resampled.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

#Step 2: Convert to raster object for approxNA()
r_raster <- raster(r_resampled)

#Step 3: Fill NA using nearest neighbor
ref_raster_r <- raster(ref_raster)  # convert SpatRaster to RasterLayer

s <- stack(ref_raster_r,r_raster)
r_filled <- approxNA(s, method = "constant")

#Step 4: Mask to reference extent
r_masked <- mask(r_filled, raster(ref_raster))

  # Step 5: Save
writeRaster(r_masked$NVDI_MAY_AP_2015, "r_masked.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

```

Automated

```{r}
library(terra)
library(raster)

# -------------------------------
# Set paths
# -------------------------------

ref_path <- "temp_bio_1/AP_CHELSA_bio1_1981-2010_V.2.1.tif"  # Reference raster
input_dir <- "raster_raw"         # Folder with input rasters
output_dir <- "resampled_filled"  # Output folder

# -------------------------------
# Load reference raster
# -------------------------------

ref_raster <- rast(ref_path)
ref_raster_r <- raster(ref_raster)  # Convert to raster format for approxNA()

# -------------------------------
# List input raster files
# -------------------------------

raster_files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

# -------------------------------
# Process each raster file
# -------------------------------

for (f in raster_files) {
  cat("🔄 Processing:", f, "\n")
  
  # Load and resample
  r <- rast(f)
  r_resampled <- resample(r, ref_raster, method = "near")

  # Convert to raster object for approxNA
  r_raster <- raster(r_resampled)
  
  # Stack with reference layer
  s <- stack(ref_raster_r, r_raster)

  # Fill NA using approxNA (nearest neighbor style)
  r_filled <- approxNA(s, method = "constant")

  # Mask to reference extent
  r_masked <- mask(r_filled, ref_raster_r)
  
  # Extract layer name from filename
  out_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  out_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(out_name, "_resampled_filled.tif"))

  # Save output
  writeRaster(r_masked[[2]], filename = out_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  
  cat("✅ Saved:", out_path, "\n")
}
```

Now in a batch process

``` r
for (infile in raster_files) {
  if (basename(infile) == basename(ref_path)) next  # skip reference

  cat("🔄 Processing:", basename(infile), "\n")

  # Step 1: Load and resample with terra
  r <- rast(infile)
  r_resampled <- resample(r, ref_raster, method = "bilinear")

  # Step 2: Convert to raster object for approxNA()
  r_raster <- raster(r_resampled)

  # Step 3: Fill NA using nearest neighbor
  r_filled <- approxNA(r_raster, method = "ngb")

  # Step 4: Mask to reference extent
  r_masked <- mask(r_filled, raster(ref_raster))

  # Step 5: Save
  outname <- file.path(output_dir, basename(infile))
  writeRaster(r_masked, outname, overwrite = TRUE)

  cat("✅ Saved:", outname, "\n\n")
}

cat("🎉 All rasters resampled, filled with nearest neighbor, and saved.\n")
```
